abstract.t: This document describes a generic solution of congestion avoidance, which is aimed at providing local link congestion avoidance within the Segment Routing (SR) framework. Based on the concept of Topology Independent Loop-Free Alternate (TI- LFA) Fast Reroute (FRR), the selected shortest path can bypass the congested link while avoiding the formation of micro-loops. The advantage of this solution is that it does not require any protocol extension.
